situation comedy: The situation comedy made the whole family laugh every Friday evening.
这部情景喜剧让全家人每个周五晚上都大笑不已。
soap opera: My grandmother never misses her favorite soap opera in the afternoon.
我奶奶下午从不错过她最爱看的肥皂剧。
find out: I called the cinema to find out what time the movie started.
我打电话给电影院，想弄清楚电影几点开始。
action movie: We watched an exciting action movie full of car chases and fights.
我们看了一部充满飙车和打斗的精彩动作片。
be ready to: She is always ready to help her classmates with their homework.
她总是愿意帮助同学们做作业。
dress up: The children dressed up as animals for the school party.
孩子们在学校晚会上装扮成各种动物。
take sb.’s place: Nobody can take your place in this team, so please stay.
没有人能取代你在这个团队中的位置，所以请留下来。
do a good job: You did a good job cleaning the classroom today.
你今天把教室打扫得很好，干得不错。
grow up: What do you want to be when you grow up?
computer programmer: His brother works as a computer programmer in a big company.
他哥哥在一家大公司当计算机程序员。
be sure about: Are you sure about the answer to this question?
你对这道题的答案有把握吗？
make sure: Please make sure all the lights are off before you leave.
离开前请确保所有的灯都关了。
be able to: After months of practice, he was able to swim across the river.
经过几个月的练习，他终于能游过这条河了。
at the beginning of: We usually make plans at the beginning of the new year.
我们通常在新年伊始制定计划。
write down: Write down my phone number in case you need help.
把我的电话号码写下来，以防你需要帮助。
have to do with: His sadness may have to do with the low exam score.
他的难过可能和这次考试的低分有关。
take up: He decided to take up photography as a new hobby.
他决定开始摄影，作为一项新爱好。
school work: Playing too many computer games is bad for your school work.
玩太多电脑游戏对你的功课有害。
agree with: I agree with you that this plan needs more discussion.
我同意你的看法，这个计划需要更多讨论。
play a part: Everyone should play a part in keeping our city clean.
每个人都应该参与到保持城市清洁的行动中来。
space station: The astronauts lived on the space station for six months.
宇航员们在太空站上生活了六个月。
over and over again: She read the letter over and over again before replying.
她反复读了好几遍那封信才回信。
hundreds of: Hundreds of visitors came to see the flower show last weekend.
上周末数百名游客前来观看花展。
fall down: Be careful, or you may fall down on the icy road.
小心点，不然你可能会在结冰的路上摔倒。
milk shake: The children shared a large banana milk shake after lunch.
孩子们午饭后分享了一大杯香蕉奶昔。
turn on: Could you turn on the TV? The news is starting.
你能打开电视吗？新闻要开始了。
prepare for: The students are working hard to prepare for the final exams.
学生们正在努力学习，为期末考试做准备。
another time: I'm busy tonight, but let's meet another time.
我今晚很忙，但我们另找时间见面吧。
hang out: We like to hang out at the shopping mall on Saturdays.
我们周六喜欢去购物中心闲逛。
the day before yesterday: It started raining the day before yesterday and hasn't stopped.
前天开始下雨，到现在还没停。
the day after tomorrow: My cousin is arriving the day after tomorrow, not today.
我表哥是后天到，不是今天。
look after: Could you look after my dog while I'm on holiday?
我度假期间你能帮我照看我的狗吗？
turn down: Please turn down the music; the baby is sleeping.
请把音乐调小声点，宝宝在睡觉。
look forward to: I look forward to hearing from you soon.
我期待早日收到你的来信。
hear from: I haven't heard from my old friend since last summer.
从去年夏天起我就没收到老朋友的来信了。
potato chips: He opened a bag of potato chips and watched the game.
他打开一袋薯片，看起了比赛。
keep…to oneself: She decided to keep the surprising news to herself for a while.
她决定暂时把这个惊人的消息保密。
in half: He cut the apple in half and gave one piece to me.
他把苹果切成两半，给了我一块。
fall in love with: She fell in love with this quiet little town at first sight.
她对这座宁静的小镇一见钟情。
connect … with: You can connect your phone with the computer to copy the photos.
你可以把手机和电脑连接起来复制照片。
